strategy.primary: Delayed-trigger abuse: on your own turn, let the 'at the beginning of the next end step' liability (lose the game, sacrifice, exile) go on the stack, then tap Obeka to end the turn and exile it. Risky extra turns become free extra turns, and temporary tokens, clones and reanimations become permanent.
strategy.secondary: Kiki-Jiki/Twinflame clone infinites and Isochron Scepter + Final Fortune (+ Obeka or Sundial) infinite turns.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Obeka, Brute Chronologist
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text: {T}: The player whose turn it is may end the turn. (Exile all spells and abilities from the stack. The player whose turn it is discards down to their maximum hand size. Damage wears off, and "this turn" and "until end of turn" effects end.)

identity.why: Ends the turn to erase delayed liabilities.
Extra turn whose loss trigger Obeka erases.
